meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Indian skin par **white cast na chhodne ke liye chemical ya hybrid sunscreen** sabse reliable hota hai; traditional mineral sunscreens mein zinc oxide/titanium dioxide ke kaaran cast aa sakta hai.[2][3]

**Best overall recommendation:** **Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++** — lightweight, fragrance-free aur medium-to-deep Indian skin tones par generally invisible finish deta hai.[8]

Skin type ke hisaab se alternatives:

- **Oily/acne-prone:** **Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++** ya **Plum SPF 50 PA++++** — lightweight, non-greasy options.[6][8]
- **Normal/dry skin:** **PHD Panthenol Hydrating Gel Sunscreen SPF 60 PA++++** — hydrating gel texture aur no-white-cast finish.[3]
- **Tinted option:** **Lakmé Sun Expert Tinted Sunscreen SPF 50** — tint cast ko hide karta hai aur most Indian skin tones par suit kar sakta hai.[1]
- **Budget/easily available:** **Neutrogena Ultra Sheer SPF 50+** — normal-oily skin ke liye lightweight aur water-resistant, lekin alcohol ki wajah se very dry ya sensitive skin ko irritate kar sakta hai.[7]

**Kaise lagayein:** Face aur neck ke liye do-finger amount lagayein, bahar rehne par lagbhag har 2 ghante reapply karein.[3] Pehle jawline par patch test kar lena—“no white cast” skin tone aur formula ke hisaab se thoda vary kar sakta hai.
